comment: UserInfo accepts the Access Token only in the Authorization header. The body (RFC 6750, Section 2.2) is optional and not supported.
Users only have first and last names, so the profile Scope returns name, given_name and family_name, none of the other profile claims.
By design, ID Tokens contain the same claims as UserInfo for the approved Scopes (docs/reference/openid-connect.md), so Clients need no UserInfo call. The specifications allow it.
As for oidcc-scope-email: ID Tokens contain the claims of the approved Scopes by design.
acr_values is ignored and ID Tokens have no acr claim; planned with multi-factor authentication.
The claims parameter is not supported (claims_parameter_supported is false), so name is only returned with the profile Scope.
